intro.h2: The simple fix people want to tell everyone about
paragraphs: Jersey Shore Tub and Tile Reglazing offers tub reglazing in Toms River, a fix many homeowners do not even know exists. Instead of tearing out a tub, shower pan or wall of tile because of the color or the wear, Denis refinishes it in place so it looks clean and new.

One customer had remodeled a small master bath with a marble floor, a new vanity and shower doors, but could not stop staring at a yellowish beige shower pan. Her tile guy suggested reglazing, and Denis turned it bright white. She called it one of those transformations you want to tell everyone about. Another homeowner says Denis told him honestly that his shower was not repairable, then did what he could to make it watertight anyway.

items.name: Bathtub reglazing
items.blurb: Tub reglazing is the job most often mentioned in our reviews. Built-in tubs, drop-in tubs and heavy cast iron pedestal tubs get a new glossy surface, so a worn or dated tub looks new again without the cost and mess of replacing it.

image.alt: Bathtub and white tile surround refinished to a clean bright white

items.name: Shower pan refinishing
items.blurb: A stained or off-color shower pan can spoil an otherwise new bathroom. Reglazing turned one yellowish beige pan bright white to match a fresh marble floor and new vanity, and the homeowner says it looks so clean and new.

items.name: Tile reglazing
items.blurb: Tired of a dated tile color? Wall and floor tile can be refinished in place instead of demolished. The bathroom shown here had its walls and floor reglazed, a big change with far less disruption than a full tile tear-out.

about.h2: About Jersey Shore Tub and Tile Reglazing
about.text: Jersey Shore Tub and Tile Reglazing is a Toms River business run by Denis, who has spent more than 13 years in the reglazing profession. He refinishes bathtubs, shower pans and tile so homeowners can change a color or fix a worn surface without tearing out the bathroom. After that long in the trade, as he puts it, there is not much he has not seen. The company is licensed in New Jersey under 13VH12234300. Reviewers describe him as honest and fair, and his Facebook page shows the jobs he enjoys most, from cast iron tubs to the occasional kitchen backsplash.

image.alt: Oval drop-in soaking tub refinished in a bone finish, surrounded by gray wall and floor tile

steps.title: Call or send photos
steps.text: Call (609) 339-6239 or email a photo of your tub, shower or tile, and Denis will tell you honestly whether it can be reglazed.

steps.title: Refinish and sign off
steps.text: The surface is reglazed, and you receive a signed invoice that covers the work under a 5-year warranty.

items.name: Carlin M.
items.text: My husband and I upgraded our bathroom recently. It was one of those smaller bathrooms off the master bedroom. The shower was a fairly small stand-up shower and the pan was kind of a yellowish beige. Pretty ugly color. Anyway we put really nice marble floor in and a new vanity and new trim and new shower doors and everything was coming along great except for that ugly shower pan that I just kept staring at. Then my tile guy suggested I just have the pan reglazed and I thought, what? Are you kidding? That’s a thing? I found Dennis and he did an amazing job changing the shower pan to a bright white. It looks so clean and new! This was one of those transformations that you want to tell everyone about because the idea is so simple yet so transforming. So thank you, Dennis, I love it!

items.name: Matthew M.
items.text: If I could give 10 stars I would! Denis said my shower wasn't repairable. Instead of ripping me off he did what he could to make it water tight. Im a world full of money first people, Denis put his reputation first. He could have left he still repaired what he could. Stand up guy!

service_area.h2: Tub reglazing in Toms River and the Jersey Shore
service_area.text: Jersey Shore Tub and Tile Reglazing is based in Toms River, New Jersey, and comes to your home to do the work, since a tub or shower is refinished right where it sits. The Facebook page describes jobs in bathrooms and kitchens across NJ. If you are near Toms River and want to know whether your town is covered, call (609) 339-6239 on a weekday.

items.a: Yes. Every customer receives a signed invoice from Denis, and with that invoice the work is covered under a 5-year warranty. Keep your invoice somewhere safe so you can show it if you ever need a touch-up or have a question about the finish later on.

Yes. Jersey Shore Tub and Tile Reglazing is licensed in New Jersey, and the license number, 13VH12234300, is printed on the company logo. You are welcome to ask about it when you call or when Denis comes to your home to look at the tub or tile.

items.q: Can my shower pan or tile really change color?
items.a: Often, yes. A dated or stained shower pan, tub or tile wall can be reglazed in a fresh, bright finish without tearing anything out, and one customer's yellowish beige shower pan is now bright white. Send a photo of yours and you will get an honest answer about what reglazing can do for it.

items.q: What if my tub or shower can't be fixed?
items.a: You will get a straight answer. Send a photo first and Denis will tell you honestly whether reglazing makes sense, even when the answer is no. Reviewers say he puts his reputation ahead of making a sale and still helps where he can.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (609) 339-6239 or email jerseyshoretubandtile@yahoo.com, ideally with a photo of the tub, shower or tile you want refinished, and we will get back to you.

final_cta.h2: Keep the tub, lose the dated color
final_cta.text: Call Denis for an honest quote on reglazing your tub, shower pan or tile.
